{{Quote|About a century ago, an entrepreneur cyberformed the Tytun Four moon into an enormous databank designed to listen and record. It was operated by droids and protected by mercenary contract. Like all archives, it ran out of space.|Keeper|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Tytun Four''' was one of the eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tytun]]. About a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Galactic War]], an entrepreneur cyberformed Tytun Four into a massive [[Memory bank/Legends|databank]] designed to observe and record [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] activity. The [[Tytun Rings]], a series of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] converted into databanks, orbited the moon and acted as additional storage.
